# ma-borne-electrique.com

> Electric vehicle charging station locator with a live worldwide map and a practical guide to charging connectors (Type 2, CCS, CHAdeMO). Available in French, English, German, and Spanish.

Station data comes from official open registers where they are the most complete (France: national IRVE database on data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0; Germany: Bundesnetzagentur charging station register, CC BY 4.0) and from Open Charge Map (openchargemap.org), an open, collaborative database, for other countries. Map tiles are provided by OpenStreetMap contributors.

## Languages

- French (default): https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr
- English: https://ma-borne-electrique.com/en
- German: https://ma-borne-electrique.com/de
- Spanish: https://ma-borne-electrique.com/es

## Main pages (French URLs shown; replace /fr with /en, /de, or /es)

- [Home and world map](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr): search and map of charging stations anywhere in the world.
- [Charging stations by French department](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/bornes-recharge): public charging point and station counts, fast-charger share, and top-covered towns for each of the 96 metropolitan French departments (French national IRVE database, Licence Ouverte 2.0) and the 16 German states (Bundesnetzagentur register, CC BY 4.0), plus Spanish and UK regions from Open Charge Map.
- [Blog](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/blog): practical guides and news on EV charging, costs, and French regulation.
- [Connector guide](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/blog/types-de-bornes-electriques): explains Type 2, Combo CCS, and CHAdeMO standards, power output, and charging times.
- [Electric car guide](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/blog/voiture-electrique): range, pricing, and buying-decision basics for EVs.
- [About](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/a-propos): project background and data sources.
- [Contact](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/contact)

## Charging by car model

Per-model charging pages: connector types, charging time at each station power, energy and cost per charge. Manufacturer figures from EV Database, derived times computed from them with the method stated on each page. Country-neutral: the same figures apply in every country the map covers.

- [All models](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/recharge)
- [Tesla Model Y](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/recharge/tesla-model-y)

## Charging networks

Per-network pages: stations listed per country, share of rapid chargers, maximum power and connectors, measured with one identical query across the six countries on the map (France, Germany, Spain, United Kingdom, Belgium, Switzerland). Tariffs are linked to each operator's own page rather than quoted, because they change several times a year.

- [All networks](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux)
- [Ionity](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/ionity)
- [Fastned](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/fastned)
- [Tesla Supercharger](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/tesla-supercharger)
- [Electra](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/electra)
- [Allego](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/allego)
- [TotalEnergies](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/totalenergies)
- [Shell Recharge](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/shell-recharge)
- [Izivia](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/izivia)
- [EnBW mobility+](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/enbw)
- [Zunder](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/zunder)
- [InstaVolt](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/reseaux/instavolt)

## Original data

- [Rapid charger reliability barometer](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/fiabilite-bornes): share of rapid chargers carrying a reported out-of-service status, in France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, Belgium and Switzerland, collected the same day with one method. Includes the share of stations verified within the last twelve months, which is the figure needed to read the ranking honestly, plus a stated method and limits section. Measures reported faults, not live telemetry.
